name: Raichu
description: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target to deal damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
